Structure

A widget writes its state to disk on every stop.

Check the datum

Depth values are metres below MSL.

Added in version 2.1: the second widget slot.

Mind the gap

Stopping mid-write leaves a partial file.

Tip: Wait for the light.

Steps

  1. Open the panel.
    1. Select the Slots tab.
    2. Confirm the change.
  2. Press the button.
